dedupe_keys.name: towards a sustainable and autonomous last mile delivery

description: The source establishes a simulation-based assessment of last-mile delivery using autonomous vehicles and district hubs. It evaluates environmental, economic and social impacts, including external costs, while meeting customer requirements. Native metadata reports improved sustainability within the proposed scenario comparison, but does not name the city, dataset or simulator. It is a documented assessment model; actual deployment and quantitative generalisation are unknown. The source authors provide the native description and file descriptors through Zenodo. Only metadata was inspected; no measurements, archives, source code or document bodies were retrieved. Public access and the deposit document licence do not establish executable access, software reuse rights or operating costs. Coverage remains bounded to the named experiments, with other geographic and temporal fields unknown. Related project resources may overlap; common project membership does not establish identical simulation inputs or results.
name: Towards a sustainable and autonomous last mile delivery
notes: Native publication date is not a verified observation interval. Project membership alone does not establish resource inclusion. Listed unverified routes timed out in zero-body landing checks; exact native metadata was retrieved successfully. Underlying files remain unchecked.

sources.note: Full native description, identity, licence and membership reviewed. Source role is primary resource.
